evidence: Frozen task files hash-match manifest.json (task.toml ac664d0e..., tests/Dockerfile 72998ab8..., tests/test.sh bd682592..., all five judge.toml hashes). (1) Separate verifier: task/task.toml [verifier] has timeout_sec = 13200.0 and environment_mode = "separate". (2) [verifier.env] (task.toml) reads exactly: REWARDKIT_JUDGE = "claude-code"; REWARDKIT_MODEL = "z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx"; ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api"; ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}"; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "" -- matches staged-task-contract.md lines 66-71 line for line; diff of the [verifier]..EOF section against the frozen template task.toml is empty (cat -A shows LF endings, no stray whitespace or extra keys). [verifier.environment] network_mode = "public", no allowed_hosts (correct per the delivery profile and the public workbook wording 'Network is public - no allowlist required'; the Internal sheet's older '+ allowlist' wording is superseded by the shipped sheet and SKILL.md delivery profile). (3) Pinned verifier image: task/tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the template (same sha 72998ab8...): FROM node:22-bookworm-slim / python:3.12-slim (tags, as template), npm @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1, pip harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7; apt packages unpinned (workbook check-dockerfiles: NOTE only); COPY . /tests only, .dockerignore identical. (4) No model in any judge.toml: grep -i 'model|reasoning|temperature' over tests/*/*/judge.toml returns nothing; each [judge] block has judge = "claude-code" (expected fallback), no weight key. Render/constraints/polish/visual [judge] headers diff-equal to template. (5) test.sh is byte-identical to template; it refuses (zero reward) when REWARDKIT_JUDGE/REWARDKIT_MODEL are unset (lines 63-65) and invokes rewardkit without any model override (line 207), so the model comes only from [verifier.env] per the cross-file agreement table. score.py and restart_mcp.py are byte-identical to template. Counterexample attempts: a broken app cannot affect this row (it is pure wiring); a conforming app cannot fail because of it unless the platform lacks OPENROUTER_API_KEY or does not recognise the model id, which is shared-template infrastructure (Colderwater lesson 11: unrecognized_model crashes zero a dimension -- check exports before blaming the task). Colderwater lessons scan for this row: only lesson 11 bears on it; no instance in source. Lesson 13 (public URLs in judge prompts) is a row-25 matter, not this row. Unmeasured (outside this row's source-level verify procedure; recorded, not waived): raw-evidence-index.json states full configured grading is absent, so no run demonstrates the judge authenticating via OpenRouter with this block. Out-of-row observation for owner: tests/scored/functional/judge.toml deviates from template ([judge] mode = "individual", timeout = 600 vs template batched/9000); not a row-10 defect (no model/credential involvement) but relevant to rows 11/24 and to single-use restart_app behaviour across individual sessions.
